list.title: Plugins
list.subtitle: Add optional Tilecast features and integrations to this installation.
list.unsupportedTitle: Plugins from a newer Tilecast release
list.unsupportedBody_one: {{ids}} is recorded as installed but not part of this release. It will not run, and its data is kept for when the newer release returns.
list.unsupportedBody_other: {{ids}} are recorded as installed but not part of this release. They will not run, and their data is kept for when the newer release returns.
list.emptyDescription: Add only the optional features this Tilecast installation needs.

catalog.installNote: An Owner or Administrator can install plugins.
catalog.title: Add a plugin
catalog.description: Optional features built into this Tilecast release. Installing one never downloads code.
catalog.emptyInstalledDescription: This installation already uses every plugin this release offers.

actionsMenu.removeDescription: {{name}} leaves this installation's Plugins list and stops affecting screens. You can add it again at any time.
actionsMenu.blockedEmpty: This plugin is still in use.
actionsMenu.blockedWait: Wait for the {{labels}} to clear, then remove the plugin.
actionsMenu.blockedDisable: Turn off the {{disable}} on this page, then remove the plugin.
actionsMenu.blockedDelete: Delete the remaining {{labels}} on this page, then remove the plugin.
actionsMenu.blockedDisableDelete: Turn off the {{disable}} and delete the remaining {{labels}} on this page, then remove the plugin.

gate.lockedDescription: {{description}} An Owner or Administrator can install it.

shared.manageNote: Owner or Administrator access is required to make changes.

brandBug.title: Brand Bug / Watermark
brandBug.subtitle: Corner marks stay on screen over playlists, Layouts, websites, and Widgets without changing what is playing.
brandBug.loadError: Brand bugs could not be loaded.
brandBug.emptyDescription: Create an instance to hold a logo, notice, or badge in a corner of selected screens.
brandBug.deleteBody: The mark will be removed from targeted Players.

editor.subtitle: One mark shows per corner. Priority decides which instance wins when two want the same corner.
editor.textHint: Shown beneath the logo, or on its own for a notice or location label.
editor.windowFromHint: Leave blank to show as soon as it is enabled.

validation.widthRange: Enter a width between 2 and 40 percent.
validation.textSizeRange: Enter a text size between 1 and 12 percent.
validation.opacityRange: Enter an opacity between 10 and 100 percent.
validation.marginRange: Enter a margin between 0 and 20 percent.
validation.contentRequired: Choose a logo image, enter text, or both.
validation.windowOrder: The end must be after the start.

countdown.title: Countdown Bar
countdown.subtitle: Timed bars run independently of the playlist and keep evaluating from the Player's cached manifest.
countdown.loadError: Countdown bars could not be loaded.
countdown.emptyDescription: Create an instance to show a locally-timed bar on selected screens.
countdown.deleteBody: The bar will be removed from targeted Players.

editor.subtitle: The Player evaluates this schedule locally. Priority decides which bar wins when instances overlap.
editor.completionHint: Shown for one minute after the target; leave blank to hide at zero.
editor.confettiLabel: Show confetti when the countdown reaches zero
editor.oneTimeHint: Entered in this browser's local time; the Player counts down to the same instant.
editor.progressHint: Drain empties the bar from right to left as the target approaches.
editor.paddingHint: Lower padding gives the message and countdown more room.
editor.textScaleHint: Increase the type size without changing the bar height.
editor.urgencyDescription: Change the bar automatically as the target approaches. Untouched stage times follow the total lead time; custom values stay fixed. Completed messages return to the normal size.
editor.pulseHint: The bar and text grow by 25% during this final stage.

validation.timezone: Enter an IANA timezone such as America/Chicago.
validation.wholeMinutes: Enter a whole number of minutes.
validation.leadRange: Lead time must be between 1 and 43200 minutes.
validation.heightRange: Enter a height between 40 and 320 pixels.
validation.textScaleRange: Enter a text size between 25 and 500 percent.
validation.soonRange: Starting soon must begin between 1 and 1440 minutes before zero.
validation.wholeSeconds: Enter a whole number of seconds.
validation.urgentRange: Urgent must begin between 2 and 3600 seconds before zero.
validation.pulseRange: Pulse must begin between 1 and 60 seconds before zero.
validation.weeklyRequired: Choose a target time and at least one day.
validation.oneTimeRequired: Choose the one-time target date and time.
validation.stageOrder: Stages must begin in order: starting soon, urgent, then pulse.

noiseMeter.title: Noise Meter
noiseMeter.subtitle: A bottom bar that appears only while the room stays too loud, and hides itself when it settles.
noiseMeter.platformNotice: Noise Meter runs on Linux Player only, using that player's default microphone. Audio is measured on the device and never sent to Tilecast, and nothing is recorded. Android Players ignore it.
noiseMeter.loadError: Noise meters could not be loaded.
noiseMeter.emptyDescription: Create an instance to watch room noise on selected Linux players.
noiseMeter.deleteBody: Targeted players will stop measuring room noise.

editor.subtitle: The bar appears only after the room stays loud, and an emergency alert always replaces it.
editor.scaleHint: Noise levels are relative to this player's microphone and are not calibrated decibel measurements.
editor.messageHint: Shown on the right of the bar. Leave blank to show “Too loud”.
editor.warningHint: Where the yellow zone begins. The bar also hides below this level.
editor.loudHint: Where the red zone begins and the bar can appear.
editor.sensitivityHint: Raise it for a quiet microphone, lower it for a hot one.
editor.timingDescription: Separate delays keep a single shout from raising the bar and a brief pause from dropping it.
editor.showAfterHint: How long the room must stay too loud before the bar appears.
editor.hideAfterHint: How long the room must stay below the warning level before the bar hides.
editor.windowDescription: The room is measured either way. This decides only when a too-loud room may put the bar on screen.
editor.windowEnabledLabel: Only show during a set time window
editor.untilHint: An end before the start runs the window overnight.
editor.windowNote: Outside the window the player keeps measuring and the bar stays down. An emergency alert is never affected by this window.
editor.historyDescription: Saves only relative noise-level measurements. Microphone audio is never recorded or uploaded.
editor.retentionHint: How long measurements are kept before they are removed automatically.
editor.activeHoursNote: Outside active hours the player stops listening entirely rather than measuring and discarding: the microphone is released until the next active window.

validation.sensitivityRange: Enter a sensitivity between 25 and 300 percent.
validation.heightRange: Enter a height between 40 and 320 pixels.
validation.timezone: Enter an IANA timezone such as America/Chicago.
validation.windowDifferent: The window must start and end at different times.
validation.levelOrder: The warning level must be below the too loud level.

history.subtitle: Measurements the player recorded locally and delivered on its ordinary heartbeat.
history.privacyNotice: Noise history stores relative noise-level measurements for graphs and reports. Tilecast never records or stores microphone audio. Levels are relative to each player's own microphone and are not calibrated decibel measurements.
history.screenHint: Levels are relative to each player's own microphone, so screens are compared with care.
history.exportTitle: Export the selected range and screen
history.combining: Combining {{count}} screens. Each player's levels come from its own microphone, so a combined view describes the group rather than comparing rooms.
history.emptyDescription: History appears once a targeted Linux player has been measuring and has delivered a heartbeat.
history.chartDescription: Average and peak, against this meter's own thresholds. Periods with no monitoring are left blank.

chart.aria: Noise Level over time. Warning level {{warning}}, too loud level {{loud}}.
chart.description: Average and peak Noise Level are shown over time. Gaps indicate periods with no monitoring. The warning threshold is {{warning}}; the too-loud threshold is {{loud}}.

history.dailyDescription: Days without monitoring are omitted rather than shown as silent.
